data.exact_reserve_text: The result included a release from prior year reserves of GBP 32.4m (2014, GBP 33.6m release). This release is a result of the Markel strategy to reserve prudently, more favourable claims development than originally anticipated and the work of our claims department in dealing with claims in an expeditious manner.

prior_year_events.impact_description: The 2011, 2012 and 2013 years experienced natural catastrophe losses totalling GBP 83.2m which adversely affected underwriting results for those years.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a gross release on prior years of approximately GBP 12.6m (about 1.7% of opening gross claims outstanding), driven principally by favourable claims development and the group's prudent reserving approach. The managing agent also highlights a reported release from prior year reserves of GBP 32.4m in the narrative (this appears to be a net/reinsurance-effect figure); the gross movement used here was calculated from the syndicate's published gross claims development table for underwriting years 2011-2013.

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior-year development was not explicitly provided as a single GROSS line item in the movement notes. The narrative quotes a 'release from prior year reserves of GBP 32.4m' (likely NET after reinsurance). Therefore the gross prior-year movement was calculated from the published gross claims development table (claims triangle) excluding the two most recent underwriting years (2015 and 2014). The triangle includes an 'All prior years' aggregate column which was excluded from the diagonal calculation as required. The calculated gross PYD (-GBP 12.617m) differs from the narrative (GBP 32.4m) which appears to be net of reinsurance or from a different aggregation; users should note the net/gross distinction.
